notes: CONSISTENCY VERDICT: highly reproducible. Across 3 repeats per eval, with_skill pass_rate = 0.99 ± 0.015 overall. Per-eval: file-upload 0.97±0.00, subscription 1.00±0.00, marketplace 0.99±0.017, notifications 1.00±0.00. Three of four evals show ZERO run-to-run variance.

Structural output is essentially deterministic: all 7 named sections, depth marker, CAP-NN IDs, all six per-capability fields, WHAT-not-HOW discipline, and researcher/librarian deferral appeared identically in every single run. No assertion 'flickers' on the formatting/structure dimension.

CONSISTENT (not flaky) DEFECT: file-upload-quick produced exactly 5 capabilities in all 3 runs (5/5/5), failing 'Covers 1-3 capabilities (quick depth)' every time. This is deterministic over-scoping, not noise — the skill reliably ignores the quick-depth 1-3 ceiling. This is the #1 fix candidate and it will be measurable: a fix should flip this assertion green in all runs.

ONE GENUINELY FLAKY ASSERTION: marketplace-platform-deep capability count varied 14 / 16 / 13 across runs. Run-2's 16 breached the documented deep ceiling of 15, failing 'Covers 8-15 capabilities (deep depth)' in 1 of 3 runs (the only assertion in the whole suite that flips pass/fail across repeats). The deep band's upper bound is slightly loose; the skill occasionally splits concerns into a 16th capability.

Capability-count variance by depth: quick=5/5/5 (tight but wrong band), standard=8/7/7 (stable, in-band), deep=14/16/13 (widest spread, occasionally out-of-band), notifications=8/9/8 (stable). Variance grows with feature scope, as expected — deep breakdowns have more legitimate ways to partition capabilities.
Timing/token reproducibility is also tight: e.g. file-upload 99.3/99.0/103.9s and 31.1k/30.9k/31.6k tokens. Run cost is predictable per eval.

Non-discriminating + soft assertions persist from iteration 1: generic topic-coverage checks pass for baseline too, and 'checks existing knowledge via librarian before starting' passes on documented intent rather than a real tool call (librarian unavailable in-harness). Both flagged by all graders. Reword the librarian assertion and/or expose librarian in the eval env to make it verifiable.
Skill effect remains large and stable vs baseline: 0.99 vs 0.17 (delta +0.82), at a cost of +72s and +17k tokens per run.
